headline: Utilities threaten action if lawmakers fail to cut their wildfire liability risk
summary: Top executives of California's two biggest utilities warned they would take action to protect their shareholders if Sacramento lawmakers fail to pass legislation limiting their companies' liabilities for wildfires sparked by their equipment
